title: Lundey browser game component diagram
description: The browser side of Lundey: the engine, the canvas UI and the page that runs them. Nothing here talks to a server.

components.name: Lundey browser game
components.responsibility: Everything that runs in the browser.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The Game, its burrows, its numbers, its seeded generator and the demo's player; no page.

components.name: UI
components.responsibility: The drawn cast, canvas drawing, controls and sound.

components.name: Page (main.ts)
components.responsibility: The loop at sixty steps a second, the canvas's size, the best score and the sound setting, the demo, the pause when the tab is hidden, and which of PLAY and PAUSE the page shows.

components.name: Browser localStorage
components.responsibility: Keeps the best score and the sound setting on the device.

relationships.description: The entry point, bundled as game.js.
Makes the Game, steps it, starts its demo and asks the autopilot for the demo's directions.
Reads Controls once a step, draws with Renderer once a frame and plays each event with Sound.
Draws a Game, produces its Input and sounds its events.
lundey.best and lundey.sound, read at load and written when they change.
